```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)

BASE <- "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/pbnb-airbnb-log-jrr-jpy"

# --- KPI France multi-niveaux ---
kpi_fr <- read.csv(file.path(BASE, "data/interim/kpi_france_byterr_2506.csv"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Refs
ref_monde <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "ref_monde")
ref_europe <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "ref_europe")
ref_france <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "country")

# Paris : city + arr
paris_city <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "city", territory == "paris")
paris_arr <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "arr", city == "paris") |> arrange(territory)
paris_iris <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "iris", city == "paris")

# BAB : 3 villes city + iris
bab_cities <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "city", territory %in% c("biarritz", "bayonne", "anglet"))
bab_iris <- kpi_fr |> filter(level == "iris", city %in% c("biarritz", "bayonne", "anglet",
                                                            "pays-basque"))

# --- GeoJSON IRIS ---
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/vince/DBD-datab/TDC-ref/geo-shape-raw/CONTOURS-IRIS_3-0__GPKG_LAMB93_FXX_2025-01-01/iris.gpkg"
lyr <- st_layers(gpkg_path)$name[1]

# Paris IRIS
paris_sf <- st_read(gpkg_path,
  query = sprintf("SELECT * FROM \"%s\" WHERE code_iris LIKE '75%%'", lyr),
  quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 0.00005, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  select(code_iris, nom_iris)

# BAB IRIS (Bayonne 64102, Biarritz 64122, Anglet 64024)
bab_where <- "code_iris LIKE '64102%' OR code_iris LIKE '64122%' OR code_iris LIKE '64024%'"
bab_sf <- st_read(gpkg_path,
  query = sprintf("SELECT * FROM \"%s\" WHERE %s", lyr, bab_where),
  quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 0.00005, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  select(code_iris, nom_iris)

# Paris arrondissements (dissolve IRIS)
paris_arr_sf <- paris_sf |>
  mutate(arr_code = substr(code_iris, 1, 5)) |>
  group_by(arr_code) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop")

# BAB communes (dissolve IRIS)
bab_com_sf <- bab_sf |>
  mutate(com_code = substr(code_iris, 1, 5)) |>
  group_by(com_code) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop")

# Export GeoJSON strings
write_geojson <- function(sf_obj) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")
  st_write(sf_obj, tmp, driver = "GeoJSON", quiet = TRUE)
  paste(readLines(tmp, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}

paris_iris_geojson <- write_geojson(paris_sf)
paris_arr_geojson <- write_geojson(paris_arr_sf)
bab_iris_geojson <- write_geojson(bab_sf)
bab_com_geojson <- write_geojson(bab_com_sf)

# --- DDICT (passé brut en string JSON, parsé côté OJS) ---
ddict_str <- paste(readLines(file.path(BASE, "reports/helpers/ddict-airbnb.json"),
                              warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")

# --- ojs_define ---
ojs_define(
  paris_city_data = paris_city,
  paris_arr_data = paris_arr,
  paris_iris_data = paris_iris,
  bab_cities_data = bab_cities,
  bab_iris_data = bab_iris,
  ref_monde_data = ref_monde,
  ref_europe_data = ref_europe,
  ref_france_data = ref_france,
  paris_iris_geojson = paris_iris_geojson,
  paris_arr_geojson = paris_arr_geojson,
  bab_iris_geojson = bab_iris_geojson,
  bab_com_geojson = bab_com_geojson,
  ddict_json = ddict_str
)
```

<!-- &s IMPORTS_OJS -->

```{ojs}
//| label: imports
//| include: false

// Helpers mutils (symlinks)
bins = import("./helpers/bins.js")
maplib = import("./helpers/maplibre.js")
tbl = import("./helpers/tableojs.js")

// DDICT → window pour tableojs
{
  const full = JSON.parse(ddict_json);
  const raw = full.indicators || full;
  const dd = {};
  for (const [k, e] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (k.startsWith("_") || !e.type) continue;
    dd[k] = {
      label: e.medium || e.short || k,
      short: e.short || k,
      type: e.type, unit: e.unit || "",
      desc: e.description || e.long || ""
    };
  }
  window.DDICT = dd;
}
```

## Paris

```{ojs}
//| label: paris-kpi
{
  const pk = transpose(paris_city_data)[0];
  const fN = (n) => n != null ? Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—";
  const fP = (n) => n != null ? n.toFixed(1) + " %" : "—";

  const kpi = document.createElement("div");
  kpi.className = "pbnb-kpi";
  const items = [
    { v: fN(pk.vol_n_ann), l: "Annonces", accent: false },
    { v: fN(pk.px_entire_med) + " €", l: "Prix méd. entier", accent: true },
    { v: fP(pk.str_entire_pct), l: "% entiers", accent: false },
    { v: fP(pk.pct_multi), l: "% multi-hôtes", accent: true },
    { v: pk.listings_1000hab?.toFixed(1), l: "Ann./1 000 hab.", accent: false },
    { v: fN(pk.act_revenu_med) + " €", l: "Revenu méd.", accent: false },
    { v: pk.actrv_note_glb?.toFixed(2) + "/5", l: "Note", accent: false },
  ];
  for (const it of items) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "pbnb-kpi-item";
    d.innerHTML = `<span class="pbnb-kpi-val${it.accent ? ' accent' : ''}">${it.v}</span><span class="pbnb-kpi-label">${it.l}</span>`;
    kpi.appendChild(d);
  }
  kpi;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: paris-row
{
  // Data
  const irisData = transpose(paris_iris_data);
  const arrData = transpose(paris_arr_data);
  const cityRow = transpose(paris_city_data)[0];
  const refFr = transpose(ref_france_data)[0];

  const isIris = maille === "iris";
  const geoRaw = isIris ? paris_iris_geojson : paris_arr_geojson;
  const geo = JSON.parse(geoRaw);
  const data = isIris ? irisData : arrData;
  const codeCol = isIris ? "code_iris" : "arr_code";
  const codeProp = isIris ? "code_iris" : "arr_code";

  // DataMap : code → row
  const dataMap = new Map();
  for (const d of data) {
    const code = isIris ? d.code_iris : d.territory?.replace("paris_", "");
    if (code) dataMap.set(code, d);
  }

  // Arr dataMap: arr_code (5 chiffres) → row
  const dataMapGeo = new Map();
  if (isIris) {
    for (const d of data) {
      if (d.code_iris) dataMapGeo.set(d.code_iris, d);
    }
  } else {
    // arr géo a arr_code = "75101"..."75120", data a territory = "paris_1er"..."paris_20e"
    const ARR_NUM = {};
    for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
      const suffix = i === 1 ? "1er" : i + "e";
      ARR_NUM["751" + String(i).padStart(2, "0")] = "paris_" + suffix;
    }
    for (const d of arrData) {
      for (const [geoCode, terrName] of Object.entries(ARR_NUM)) {
        if (d.territory === terrName) dataMapGeo.set(geoCode, d);
      }
    }
  }

  // Bins
  const vals = data.map(d => +d[indicateur]).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
  const binsResult = vals.length > 5 ? bins.autoBins(vals, indicateur) : null;
  const getColor = binsResult ? bins.makeGetColor(binsResult) : () => "#ccc";

  // Build GeoJSON enrichi
  const enriched = maplib.buildChoroplethSource(
    geo.features, dataMapGeo, indicateur, getColor,
    { codeProperty: codeProp, extraProps: ["nom_iris", "territory"] }
  );

  // Layout
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "pbnb-city-row";

  const mapCol = document.createElement("div");
  mapCol.className = "pbnb-map-col";
  const mapDiv = document.createElement("div");
  mapDiv.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:460px;";
  mapCol.appendChild(mapDiv);
  row.appendChild(mapCol);

  const tableCol = document.createElement("div");
  tableCol.className = "pbnb-table-col";
  row.appendChild(tableCol);

  yield row;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));

  // Map
  const bds = maplib.computeBounds(enriched.features);
  const { map, Popup } = await maplib.createOTTDMap(mapDiv, {
    maxZoom: 16, center: bds.center, zoom: 11
  });
  await new Promise(r => { if (map.loaded()) r(); else map.on("load", r); });

  const layers = maplib.addChoroplethLayers(map, "choro", enriched, {
    prefix: "paris", fillOpacity: 0.75, lineColor: "#999", lineWidth: 0.3,
    codeProperty: codeProp
  });
  maplib.attachTooltip(map, layers.fillLayerId, (props) => {
    const label = props._label || props[codeProp] || "?";
    const val = props._val;
    const dd = window.DDICT?.[indicateur] || {};
    const valStr = val != null ? (dd.type === "pct" ? (+val).toFixed(1) + "%" : (+val).toLocaleString("fr-FR")) : "n.d.";
    return `<b style="color:#fff">${label}</b><br><span style="color:#93c5fd">${dd.short || indicateur}</span> : <b>${valStr}</b>`;
  }, { Popup });
  maplib.attachHighlight(map, layers.fillLayerId, layers.hoverLayerId, { codeProperty: codeProp });

  if (bds.bounds) map.fitBounds(bds.bounds, { padding: 20, duration: 0 });

  // Legend
  if (binsResult) {
    const dd = window.DDICT?.[indicateur] || {};
    const labels = [];
    const t = binsResult.thresholds;
    labels.push("< " + bins.formatThreshold(t[0], dd.unit));
    for (let i = 0; i < t.length - 1; i++) {
      labels.push(bins.formatThreshold(t[i], dd.unit) + " – " + bins.formatThreshold(t[i+1], dd.unit));
    }
    labels.push("> " + bins.formatThreshold(t[t.length-1], dd.unit));
    const leg = maplib.createMapLegend(binsResult.palette, labels, {
      title: dd.short || indicateur, direction: "vertical", swatchSize: 12
    });
    maplib.setMapLegend(mapDiv, leg);
  }

  // Table
  const tableKeys = ["vol_n_ann", "px_entire_med", "str_entire_pct", "pct_multi",
    "listings_1000hab", "str_ratio_ann_hote", "act_cal_ouvert_med", "act_revenu_med", "actrv_note_glb"];

  const refRow = {
    label: "France (4 villes)",
    data: refFr,
    bgColor: "#eef2ff"
  };

  tbl.buildDataTable(tableCol, data, {
    keys: tableKeys,
    labelCol: isIris ? "nom_iris" : "territory",
    labelFallback: isIris ? "code_iris" : "territory",
    labelHeader: isIris ? "IRIS" : "Arrondissement",
    colorCol: null,
    defaultSort: indicateur,
    maxHeight: 420,
    groups: [
      { label: "Stock", cols: ["vol_n_ann"] },
      { label: "Prix", cols: ["px_entire_med"] },
      { label: "Structure", cols: ["str_entire_pct", "pct_multi"] },
      { label: "Pression", cols: ["listings_1000hab", "str_ratio_ann_hote"] },
      { label: "Activité", cols: ["act_cal_ouvert_med", "act_revenu_med", "actrv_note_glb"] }
    ],
    refRow: refRow
  });
}
```

## Biarritz · Anglet · Bayonne

```{ojs}
//| label: bab-kpi
{
  const cities = transpose(bab_cities_data);
  const total = d3.sum(cities, d => d.vol_n_ann);
  const pxMed = d3.median(cities.map(d => d.px_entire_med).filter(v => v != null));
  const fN = (n) => n != null ? Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—";

  const kpi = document.createElement("div");
  kpi.className = "pbnb-kpi";
  const items = [
    { v: fN(total), l: "Annonces (3 comm.)", accent: false },
    { v: fN(pxMed) + " €", l: "Prix méd. entier", accent: true },
    { v: cities.length + " communes", l: "BAB", accent: false },
  ];
  for (const c of cities) {
    items.push({ v: fN(c.vol_n_ann), l: c.territory, accent: false });
  }
  for (const it of items) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "pbnb-kpi-item";
    d.innerHTML = `<span class="pbnb-kpi-val${it.accent ? ' accent' : ''}">${it.v}</span><span class="pbnb-kpi-label">${it.l}</span>`;
    kpi.appendChild(d);
  }
  kpi;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: bab-row
{
  const irisData = transpose(bab_iris_data);
  const citiesData = transpose(bab_cities_data);
  const refFr = transpose(ref_france_data)[0];

  const isIris = maille === "iris";
  const geoRaw = isIris ? bab_iris_geojson : bab_com_geojson;
  const geo = JSON.parse(geoRaw);
  const data = isIris ? irisData : citiesData;
  const codeProp = isIris ? "code_iris" : "com_code";

  const dataMapGeo = new Map();
  if (isIris) {
    for (const d of data) {
      if (d.code_iris) dataMapGeo.set(d.code_iris, d);
    }
  } else {
    // commune code: Bayonne=64102, Biarritz=64122, Anglet=64024
    const COM_MAP = { "64102": "bayonne", "64122": "biarritz", "64024": "anglet" };
    for (const d of citiesData) {
      for (const [code, terr] of Object.entries(COM_MAP)) {
        if (d.territory === terr) dataMapGeo.set(code, d);
      }
    }

  const binsResult = vals.length > 3 ? bins.autoBins(vals, indicateur) : null;
  const getColor = binsResult ? bins.makeGetColor(binsResult) : () => "#ccc";

  const enriched = maplib.buildChoroplethSource(
    geo.features, dataMapGeo, indicateur, getColor,
    { codeProperty: codeProp, extraProps: ["nom_iris", "territory"] }
  );

  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "pbnb-city-row";

  const mapCol = document.createElement("div");
  mapCol.className = "pbnb-map-col";
  const mapDiv = document.createElement("div");
  mapDiv.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:460px;";
  mapCol.appendChild(mapDiv);
  row.appendChild(mapCol);

  const tableCol = document.createElement("div");
  tableCol.className = "pbnb-table-col";
  row.appendChild(tableCol);

  yield row;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));

  const bds = maplib.computeBounds(enriched.features);
  const { map, Popup } = await maplib.createOTTDMap(mapDiv, {
    maxZoom: 16, center: bds.center, zoom: 11
  });
  await new Promise(r => { if (map.loaded()) r(); else map.on("load", r); });

  const layers = maplib.addChoroplethLayers(map, "choro-bab", enriched, {
    prefix: "bab", fillOpacity: 0.75, lineColor: "#999", lineWidth: 0.3,
    codeProperty: codeProp
  });
  maplib.attachTooltip(map, layers.fillLayerId, (props) => {
    const label = props._label || "?";
    const val = props._val;
    const dd = window.DDICT?.[indicateur] || {};
    const valStr = val != null ? (dd.type === "pct" ? (+val).toFixed(1) + "%" : (+val).toLocaleString("fr-FR")) : "n.d.";
    return `<b style="color:#fff">${label}</b><br><span style="color:#93c5fd">${dd.short || indicateur}</span> : <b>${valStr}</b>`;
  }, { Popup });
  maplib.attachHighlight(map, layers.fillLayerId, layers.hoverLayerId, { codeProperty: codeProp });

  if (bds.bounds) map.fitBounds(bds.bounds, { padding: 30, duration: 0 });

  if (binsResult) {
    const dd = window.DDICT?.[indicateur] || {};
    const labels = [];
    const t = binsResult.thresholds;
    labels.push("< " + bins.formatThreshold(t[0], dd.unit));
    for (let i = 0; i < t.length - 1; i++) {
      labels.push(bins.formatThreshold(t[i], dd.unit) + " – " + bins.formatThreshold(t[i+1], dd.unit));
    }
    labels.push("> " + bins.formatThreshold(t[t.length-1], dd.unit));
    const leg = maplib.createMapLegend(binsResult.palette, labels, {
      title: dd.short || indicateur, direction: "vertical", swatchSize: 12
    });
    maplib.setMapLegend(mapDiv, leg);
  }

  const tableKeys = ["vol_n_ann", "px_entire_med", "str_entire_pct", "pct_multi",
    "listings_1000hab", "str_ratio_ann_hote", "act_cal_ouvert_med", "act_revenu_med", "actrv_note_glb"];

  tbl.buildDataTable(tableCol, data, {
```
